name: Classic Kurta — Off-White
description: Breathable cotton kurta with a mandarin collar and tonal buttons. Cut relaxed through the chest, falls just right over shalwar or jeans. An everyday staple that never looks ordinary.

name: Premier Kurta — Deep Navy
description: Premium blended fabric with a subtle sheen, finished with contrast piping along the collar and placket. Made for Eid dinners, engagements, and every event in between.

name: Kameez Shalwar — Sand
description: Classic two-piece kameez shalwar in soft-washed sand cotton. Lightweight enough for summer afternoons, sharp enough for Friday prayers.

name: Waistcoat Kurta Set — Olive
description: Embroidered waistcoat layered over a solid kurta, sold as a set. The waistcoat carries light threadwork on the collar; pair it with a plain shalwar and you are dressed.

name: Cotton Panjabi — Charcoal
description: Straight-cut panjabi with full sleeves and a clean placket. Charcoal cotton that survives weekly washes and keeps its colour.

name: Designer Kurta — Ivory Embroidered
description: Statement kurta with hand-guided embroidery across the neckline. Ivory-on-ivory thread keeps it quiet; the cut does the talking.

name: Lawn 3-Piece — Emerald Bloom
description: Printed lawn shirt with dyed-to-match trousers and a chiffon dupatta. Soft, breathable, and built to last the whole season.

name: Embroidered Kurta — Blush
description: Straight-fit kurta in blush pink with resham embroidery along the neckline. Wear it with trousers for work or with a dupatta for evenings.

name: Chiffon Party Suit — Midnight
description: Three-piece formal in midnight chiffon with sequin border work. Falls fluidly, photographs beautifully, and earns its place in the wardrobe.

name: Cotton 2-Piece — Ivory
description: Everyday two-piece in breathable ivory cotton with minimal block print at the hem. The one you will reach for on busy mornings.

name: Fancy Maxi — Maroon Velvet
description: Floor-length maxi in maroon velvet with a gold-foil print yoke. Winter weddings sorted.

name: Printed Kurti — Teal
description: Short printed kurti in teal with a straight silhouette. Works over jeans, tights, or trousers without a second thought.

name: Boys Kurta — White
description: Crisp white cotton kurta for the little gentleman. Machine washable, because we know.

name: Girls Frock — Peach Bloom
description: Tiered frock in peach georgette with a satin waistband. Twirl-tested and approved.

name: Kids Shalwar Kameez Set — Sage
description: Matching shalwar kameez set in soft sage cotton, sized for school events and family dinners alike.

name: Lawn Unstitched 3-Piece — Bloom
description: Two printed lawn shirt pieces with a matching dupatta and trouser fabric. Take it to your darzi and get it made your way.

name: Khaddar Unstitched Suit — Charcoal
description: Winter-weight khaddar in deep charcoal with self-button detailing. Warm, textured, and ready for the tailor.

name: Embroidered Chiffon Unstitched — Rose
description: Embroidered chiffon front with plain back and dyed chiffon dupatta. Heavy on the neckline, light everywhere else.

name: Wool Shawl — Charcoal Weave
description: Handloom wool shawl with a fine chevron weave and tassel finish. Heavy enough for winter mornings, elegant enough to gift.

name: Cotton Scarf — Sand
description: Everyday cotton scarf in soft sand with frayed edges. Doubles as a dupatta when you travel light.
